During the [[Imperial Era]], a small '''battle group''' of the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] was stationed in orbit above [[Ilum]], serving as a [[planet]]ary [[blockade]]. The [[battle group]] was led by [[Captain]] [[Malthegn]] aboard the ''[[Hoplite]]'', a [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer|''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer]]. The battle group also consisted of several small [[frigate]]s and [[gunboat]]s.<ref name="Nexus of Power" /> By the [[time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]] after the [[Battle of Hoth]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[officer]] and [[Jedi]]-in-training [[Luke Skywalker]] slipped past the blockade to investigate Ilum, which by then consisted of at least three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="SW 19">[[Star Wars (2020) 19|''Star Wars'' (2020) 19]]</ref>
